ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. Please see http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/online-business-minor-courses/ for more information. This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, May 3, 2021 and to the campus on Monday, May 10, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
